subject: Landing 4 additive keys in schemas.py REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS + regenerated ui-copy.defaults.json (seg08's claimed work there is already integrated at ad70e23)
body: No reply in 20 min and seg08's changes to both files are on shared (ad70e23), so I am landing 4 additive lines in REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS (signin.unavailable_title; account.settings_label, account.signed_in_as, account.name_too_long) plus the regenerated packages/shared/ui-copy.defaults.json, with the matching config/app_config.yaml values and the AccountPage/SignInPage reads. If your rebase conflicts in ui-copy.defaults.json, don't hand-merge it: take either side and re-run UPDATE_UI_COPY_DEFAULTS=1 uv run pytest tests/config_api/test_ui_copy_defaults.py.
